title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Sound Devices 744T > Adobe Audition CC 2015 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a legendary four‑set 1970 show with standout acoustic gems and electric fireworks
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced SBD captures the concert with crystal‑clear balance, making listeners feel like they’re in the room.  The performance is widely hailed as one of the era’s best – an intimate acoustic set followed by a Riders of the Pine St. set and two electric marathons that deliver classics such as “Friend of the Devil,” “Dire Wolf,” and a monster “The Other One.”  Minor gripes (a out‑of‑tune Cold Rain & Snow) are far outweighed by the show’s overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive fan commentary (12 of 14 reviews 5‑star) praises both musical performance and the pristine SBD sound, with only a few mixed notes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced, crisp SBD mastered by Charlie Miller; reviewers repeatedly note great clarity, room‑like presence and minimal issues (only minor pitch‑correction comments).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Four‑set marathon: an intimate acoustic set, a brief Riders of the Pine St. interlude, then two electric sets that swing from relaxed folk to fierce jam‑filled rock, delivering a classic 1970 tour vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised repeatedly for his soaring tone and the “over the mountain” journey he provides.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed remarks – some reviewers love his amplified bass on songs like Cumberland Blues, others note occasional inaudibility in parts of the electric sets.
